description: Move low-risk verified tasks to done (or submitted ones in needs_verification, when the project's verification is off), only when the user explicitly asked: act as yourself with on_behalf_of: "human:<their name>". Medium and high risk are refused: they are accepted in the Kanban UI only. You cannot accept work you submitted. Each task is accepted or refused on its own.

actor.description: Your own agent id, e.g. agent:assistant

on_behalf_of.description: The human who asked, e.g. human:umit

name: accept_tasks
title: Accept Tasks
